groups.name: Weightless
groups.definition: Lowers weight of enemies by 1, cannot be stacked.

badges.label: Arcane Staff - Anti-Gravity Mode
badges.sourceText: Applies Weightless to all enemies on the battlefield, expands Attack Range, ATK +150% , and can attack 5 enemies Cannot use normal attacks while skill is inactive

badges.label: T1
badges.sourceText: Attacks deal an additional 30% (+5%) of her ATK as Arts Damage, increased to 45% (+10%) of ATK when attacking enemies with 3 or less Weight. While in Take Off, enemies in range are inflicted with Weightless

badges.label: T2
badges.sourceText: Applies Weightless to enemies with 80% or more HP within Attack Range

groups.name: Levitate
groups.definition: Unable to move, attack, or use special abilities, becomes an aerial enemy. Enemies with weight 3 or above gets half the levitation time.

badges.label: Gust
badges.sourceText: The next attack deals 200% ATK as Physical damage, and causes the target to Levitate for 1 seconds, then deals 200% ATK as Physical damage to it again

badges.label: Shattertide
badges.sourceText: Deals 400% ATK as Physical damage to up to 6 ground enemies in front, and cause targets with 3 or less Weight to Levitate for 4 seconds Can store 2 charges

badges.label: Judgment
badges.sourceText: Deals 300% ATK as Physical damage to all nearby ground enemies, and cause them to Levitate for 4 seconds, then bombard 12 times, each hit dealing 250% ATK as Physical damage to all enemies in a small area around a random target

badges.label: Module ISW-α (Stage 3)
badges.sourceText: Physical damage has a 50% chance to ignore 50% DEF, chance increases to 100% against aerial units; In Integrated Strategies , aerial enemies within skill range receive 140% more Physical damage; when deploying other Operators within this range, ground enemies within skill range are Levitated for 3s; this range persists after Irene retreats; when enemies within this range lose Levitation, Irene in the Deployment Waiting Zone will immediately be deployed at her former position and activate her skill, if deployment conditions allow (costs no DP )

badges.label: Module ISW-α (Stage 3)
badges.sourceText: All allies gain +7 ASPD; In Integrated Strategies , enemies being shifted or Levitated while Angelina is on the field take 60% of her ATK as Arts damage every 0.5s; when Angelina's skill is active, her attacks can Levitate the target for 3s; also, hitting the Levitated target can refresh the duration of Levitate

badges.label: In Search of Reason

badges.label: Module ISW-α (Stage 3)
badges.sourceText: When attacking aerial units, ATK increases to 145% and silences them for 5 seconds; In Integrated Strategies , gains 1 Temporary Life Point on first deployment, and the first time an enemy steps into the Objective tile, Levitates all enemies for 15 seconds; skills will simultaneously Levitate and deal damage to enemies and surrounding targets

badges.label: T1

badges.sourceText: Deals 450% ATK as Physical damage to up to 4 enemies and causes targets affected by Talent 1 to Levitate , then removes Levitate from all enemies with Levitate , activates Talent 1 on them with 100% chance, and deals 650% ATK as Physical damage Max 2 charges

badges.label: Hammerforce
badges.sourceText: ATK +100% , DEF +100% , splash attack causes units with weight 3 or less to Levitate for 0.5 s

badges.sourceText: Deals 75% ATK as Arts damage to at most 2 Ground enemies within range once every 0.5 seconds and causes targets to Levitate for 7 seconds; When a target's Levitate effect ends, deals 300% ATK as Arts damage to all enemies in a small area around that target

badges.label: Cyclone Arrow
badges.sourceText: Immediately fires three arrows, each dealing 80% of ATK as Arts damage, followed by an AoE attack dealing 400% of ATK as Arts damage to targets struck and inflicting Levitate for 1.5 seconds

badges.label: Sealant
badges.sourceText:
Stops attacking, ATK +180%, and puts herself and the Operator within Attack Range with the lowest HP percentage to Sleep until the skill ends; continuously puts enemies around herself and the target to Sleep; Talent 1 effect increases to 3.3x
Can manually deactivate skill at any time

Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 380% ATK as Arts damage
Active Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo
Skill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones

badges.sourceText: ASPD +80 ; Releases Drone to attack enemies Overload : Trait Max drone damage increased to 2 x, ATK +50% ; When the skill ends, Stunned for the same duration as Overload The Drone locks onto an enemy until the enemy is defeated or until the skill is over, then returns to the Operator.
